info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Meetings Meetings Notes-v5-spec
info.description: The Meetings Notes Retrieval API enables users to access notes associated with upcoming and past meetings. This API endpoint allows stakeholders to efficiently retrieve detailed meeting notes, facilitating better preparation and follow-up. It serves professionals such as project managers, team leaders, and administrative staff who need to refer to meeting discussions and decisions. By providing this functionality, the API enhances collaboration and knowledge sharing within organizations.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve notes associated with meetings. Users can access all relevant notes for effective meeting management and follow-up.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the notes associated with meetings. Ensure that the necessary parameters and filters are included in the body to specify which meeting notes you wish to access.
